title: 4-year-old trapped 220-ft inside borewell in Ambala dies after 19-hour rescue operation

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A tragic accident on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway in Dausa, Rajasthan, claimed at least seven lives and injured over 15 when a private bus collided with a trailer and plunged into a gorge. The incident, occurring early Wednesday, saw a fire erupt in the bus, intensifying the panic. Rescue operations were swift, with the injured being transported to Dausa district hospital for treatment. An investigation into the cause is underway.
title: 7 dead, 15 injured as bus catches fire after collision on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway

description: In a shocking turn of events, Pune Rural police revealed that realtor Ketan Agarwal's fiancée, Siya Goyal, and her boyfriend, Chetan Chaudhary, allegedly rehearsed his murder before pushing him off a cliff at Lohagad Fort. The couple confessed to practicing the act on a hill near Market Yard. Police are planning a scene reconstruction and gait analysis of Chaudhary.
title: Siya, Chetan 'rehearsed' Ketan's murder on another hill before executing it at Lohagad Fort
